prompts:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: actual static main-menu background bitmap for the videogame NO TRACE, horizontal 16:9.
Input image 1 is the old background, a reference ONLY for the nighttime infiltration setting and blue-black/red/amber identity. Redraw the scene in a radically simpler, authentic low-resolution pixel-art videogame style. Do not preserve its microtexture or single-character composition.

Primary request: a deliberately hand-designed 320 x 180 pixel-art scene, ideally deliver the actual bitmap at 320 x 180 pixels. Crisp square pixels on one consistent coarse grid, flat limited palette of about 24 to 32 colors, deliberate solid pixel clusters, stepped contours, NO antialiasing. NOT a detailed painting with a pixel filter. Each operator should be readable as a small game sprite.

Scene: a covert intelligence/military compound on a wet night. Compact concrete buildings, one clear watchtower and a smaller secondary tower, simple perimeter fence and checkpoint. A few red security lamps, small amber windows, TWO restrained flat-color blue spotlight wedges, a few simple horizontal reflection blocks on wet ground. Sparse static rain marks only. Vegetation in a few large intentional pixel clusters.

EXACTLY TWO large, clearly separate allied tactical operators occupy the RIGHT third of the image, both visible at first glance. First operator at x=84%-96%, head around y=35%, feet above y=91%; standing in a low stealth-ready pose, three-quarter back view, compact rifle carried sideways and low, weapon not firing. Second operator at x=66%-81%, head around y=57%, feet above y=91%; crouching and looking toward the compound, compact weapon pointing another safe direction, a clearly different silhouette. Second must be substantial, around 55%-65% of standing operator's visible height despite crouching, not a tiny background figure. Separate their silhouettes with a narrow dark-blue ground gap. Matching simple dark tactical kit, blocky backpacks, coherent arms/legs and simple gloves; no facial microdetails. They communicate coordinated infiltration and mutual cover, not battle or betrayal. No third person.

Composition constraints from the EXISTING UI: left 45% is very dark quiet negative space for the already implemented title and buttons. In Options, a translucent panel covers left 65%; keep BOTH operators' heads and bodies right of x=66%, and all limbs and equipment inside a safe 4% image margin. Compound recognizable mainly in center x=46%-72% and skyline. Keep foreground operators darker but readable against simpler blue midground buildings. No bright light or busy fence patterns behind the UI.
Palette: near-black #060b14, midnight #101928, deep slate #1c2c40, muted blue #31465c and #51677a, gray-blue #7b8990, sparse muted red #aa3545, amber #b99856. Use only a few discrete shades per material. Simple lighting, restrained highlights.
ABSOLUTELY NO lettering, logos, emblems, watermark, UI, fake buttons, borders or titles. The existing NO TRACE logo is loaded separately and must not be baked into this image.
Avoid photorealism, cinematic volumetric beams, gradients, tiny noisy details, cloth folds at subpixel scale, complex reflections, random dithering, scanlines, grain, screen effects, blurry edges, smoothly painted anatomy, duplicate operators, crowded equipment. Prioritize clear low-resolution shapes and mood.

Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: final static videogame background for NO TRACE.
Input image: composition reference with two allied operators. Preserve the nighttime military infiltration concept, dark empty left side and exactly TWO different coordinated poses on the right. Redraw all artwork much more coarsely.

The current reference STILL HAS TOO MUCH DETAIL. Make a genuinely LOW-RESOLUTION 16-bit videogame scene with an underlying 320 x 180 grid, as if drawn by hand at 320 x 180 and enlarged with nearest-neighbor. BIG obvious square pixels, solid flat 24-color palette, clean stair-step outlines. Every contour, plant, cloud, reflection and character must obey the SAME coarse pixel grid. No smooth gradients, no detailed illustration, no antialiasing, no subpixel cloth/skin/metal texture.

Radically simplify: compact buildings are flat dark rectangles with only 2-3 tones and a few 2x2-pixel windows. Main watchtower only bold readable shapes, no tiny wiring, pipes or intricate railings. Fences use a sparse regular pattern. Only 2 or 3 broad simple block reflections; no glittery water. Each tree/fern is 3-5 connected flat silhouette clusters, no random scattered leaves. Rain only a handful of fixed simple pixel strokes. Sky only 3 solid stepped dark-blue bands, no realistic cloud texture. Spotlights are flat 2-tone triangles, no volumetric glow.

Operators: same tactical team, clearly separated silhouettes. Standing agent at x=84%-95%, y=35%-90%; crouching agent x=66%-81%, y=56%-90%. Full bodies and weapons visible with at least4% safe border. Standing agent carries a rifle low sideways and watches toward the compound; crouched partner covers another direction. Each tactical body is a readable cluster of roughly 25x55 logical pixels, crouched one28x35, with a helmet or hood, backpack, arms and legs defined by large color blocks. Backpacks at most 4 bold rectangular pouches; no dozens of straps. Arms/hands have clear coherent contact with a simple rifle. Do not duplicate a character. No firing, no third figure, no battle. Both are unmistakably visible at thumbnail size.

Left 45% very dark quiet space for independent existing menu. Options panel covers left65%; preserve both heads/bodies to right of66%. Background tower mid-right behind them, smaller guard tower near center; checkpoint and perimeter simple, not cluttered.
Restrained shared palette: near-black, midnight blue, slate blue, desaturated blue-gray, sparse muted amber/red. 3 tones maximum per material. Strong separated foreground/midground silhouettes.
Render a complete horizontal16:9 artwork, no frame or mockup. Prefer actual output320x180 or640x360.
ABSOLUTELY NO text, logos, UI, title, watermark, borders, scanlines, grain or retro filters. The result should look like a real low-resolution game environment, not a high-resolution image with noise shaped like pixels.

recursos.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original typographic title logo for a tactical infiltration videogame named NO TRACE. One isolated horizontal logo, transparent background.
Primary request: Render exactly the two words "NO TRACE" in ALL CAPITALS. Custom drawn powerful condensed extended military techno lettering, forward slanted, strongly shaped engineered letterforms with angular cutouts and stencil breaks; premium original gaming identity, NOT just text set in a generic typeface.
Composition: Wide horizontal wordmark about 4.4:1 width to height. Letters bright off-white and restrained light-gray wear, subtle distressed small missing pixels and tiny speedline interruptions integrated into selected edges without compromising readability. A single narrow red diagonal cut/slash through the space between NO and TRACE, restrained red accent.
Text (verbatim): "NO TRACE". N O space T R A C E. No other letters, no subtitle.
Constraints: Genuine alpha transparency, no backdrop, no gradients behind the logo, no checkerboard, no framing box, no border, no cast shadow, no watermark, no mockup presentation, no icon/emblem. Transparent empty margins modest about 4 percent. Logo will be drawn over a near-black pixel art background. Must be crisp and legible at 450-pixel width. Original lettering design.
